slots.note: a composer avatar is drawn into a square slot

the documented rule is 'Icons and logos must be square and at least 48 by 48 pixels' — it names logos explicitly, so the same requirement as the composer avatar. An earlier revision allowed a non-square logo on the reasoning that 'a logo is often a wordmark'; that was a preference wearing a rule's clothes, and the approved asset is 1024x1024, so the allowance bought nothing and would have accepted a shape the portal refuses. A wordmark that cannot be square needs a different flow, not a weaker check.
